definitions.explanation: The small, flat, overlapping plates that cover the skin of fish and reptiles.

examples.english: To remove the scales of a fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鱗|うろこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ていねい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧。
examples.english: Before cooking, carefully remove the fish scales with the back of a knife.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana (うろこ) or kanji ({鱗|うろこ}). The kanji is relatively uncommon in everyday writing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{鱗|うろこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (literally, "scales fall from one's eyes") means to have a sudden realization or to see something in a completely new way. This is one of the most well-known expressions using {鱗|うろこ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鱗|うろこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove scales
- {鱗|うろこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: scales glisten
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{鱗|うろこ}: eye-opening realization
